notes.title: Changelog v1.2
notes.notes:
[b]General Gameplay:[/b]
Now Checkpoints replenish HP.,
Alarm sound added when Rhya is near Beacons. (Every Beacon have it's own alarm range).,

[b]Level 1 Axias-Prime (Easy and Normal):[/b]
HP Box module added before Beacon 1.,
Worm Boss HP scaled down 1/4.,
Danger Signs added in bottomless pits all over underground tunnel phase.,

[b]Level 2 Drein (Normal):[/b]
HP Box module added after 1st alien plant encounter.,
HP Box module added at the end of the final large platforms phase.,
Shield between Machine Gunner and Scout Mecha removed.,
General Noth Boss HP scaled down 1/5.,

[b]Level 3 Thion (Normal):[/b]
HP Box module added at the end of the first tunnel.,
MG Module added at the end of the last tunnel.,
Droko Boss HP scaled down 1/4.,

[b]Level 3 Thion (Easy):[/b]
Droko Boss HP scaled down 1/4.,

[b]Level 4 Ka-Lator (Normal):[/b]
HP Box module added before first Beacon.,
HP Box module added in the Fire Burst phase.,
Cargo Train Boss HP scaled down 1/6.,

[b]Level 4 Ka-Lator (Easy):[/b]
HP Box module added before first Beacon.,
Cargo Train Boss HP scaled down 1/6.,

[b]Level 5 Galav (Normal):[/b]
K-Roll Boss HP scaled down 1/6.,

[b]Level 6 Dabeth (Easy and Normal):[/b]
HP Box Module added before first Demon Bats encounter.,
HP Box Module added after first Demon Worm.,
HP Box Module added after third Demon Worm.,
QuickShot Module added replacing HP Box near Beacon 5.,
Checkpoint added for Aradia's second phase Bossfight.,
HP Drone now spawning sooner before Aradia's second phase Bossfight.,

[b]Level 6 Dabeth (Normal):[/b]
Aradia's second phase Battletank damage hitbox size increased (Taking damage in the whole hull).
